annotations.title: How to play an activity together

description: Get the app's own steps for playing or practising a topic with a child. topic can be an activity id, an area id, a skill or a plain topic such as "jump rope", "doctor", "swimming" or "piano"; optionally add the child's age to see only suitable activities. Returns catalog-backed steps in English and Vietnamese (including the seated, gentler and grown-up versions of movement activities), reps or seconds per band and grown-up tips with sources. Nothing is invented: if the catalog has no match, it says so. Read-only; never send a name.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216). Provide age_months OR age_years, not both. The app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9).

age_years.description: Child's age in whole years (1-18). Provide age_years OR age_months, not both. The app's content covers ages 3-9.

topic.description: An activity id (hero.frog-jumps), an area id (piano), a skill (balance) or a plain topic ("jump rope", "doctor", "twinkle", "swimming"). Never a name.

name: how_to_teach

age_bands.description: Age bands (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) the activity is made for.

id.description: Stable activity id, usable with get_activity and how_to_teach.

minutes_basis.description: computed = from reps x tempo; app-stated = a number the app states; estimate = a planning estimate, not a measurement.

needs_grown_up.description: True when the app's own notes ask a grown-up to be nearby or to join in.

source.description: Repo path the activity was read from.

title: How to play an activity together
